79610.subject: Don’t Fade NEAR
79610.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

When price and fundamentals move together, that catches my eye.

NEAR has nearly doubled in a week and is now up 178% since mid August, helped by confidential perps and a Zcash fueled swap business. The rally looks sudden, but the business underneath it has been changing for much longer.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/faf695fc-6a52-4437-b63a-2d238cf0bc79/image.png?t=1790160578)
Caption: 

Underneath the re-rating, REV has regained momentum but under a different business model. Since January 2025, execution fees fell 83%, from $120k a week to $20k. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/beec373b-0e21-4eb2-9c8a-c2823bdcfcfb/image.png?t=1790160577)
Caption: 

However, every dollar of that loss was replaced by NEAR Intents (a transaction type that lets users perform actions across different blockchains without manually managing execution routes or gas fees). Before the fee switch activation in February 2026, NEAR routed Intents volume and captured none of it. Intents now constitute ~85% of NEAR REV and NEAR is up 350% since the activation.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/2091ba2d-f0aa-43b4-9665-517453b43eea/image.png?t=1790160577)
Caption: 

This focus on Intents came at the cost of native activity. Relayer-paid (delegated) transactions were 78% of NEAR's volume in Q1 2026 and had been the bulk of it since 2024. These were gas-subsidized consumer apps, and the subsidy stopped.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/f169dae5-b109-446e-b9aa-8bb3b897dc04/image.png?t=1790160577)
Caption: 

The effect can be seen in the fee data. Token burn has fallen from 100k NEAR in January 2025 to 20k NEAR in August 2026. The monthly burn rate now sits at 0.7%, though with an all-time high of 3.4% in March 2024, the burn was insignificant anyway. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/76269fd3-30f9-4839-940a-65d7cbaa30bf/image.png?t=1790160577)
Caption: 

The activity mix for NEAR Intents is mainly deposits, withdrawals and swaps.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/96b831c4-e7b2-456e-95d1-c410d7c5e9b6/image.png?t=1790160577)
Caption: 

But swaps are where the money is made and SwapKit, a cross-chain swap SDK embedded in wallets like Ledger Live, BitPay and Trust Wallet,
